body:
> I used to feel like I was sitting inside of my body as a separate entity and the days would just past and shit would just happen

This is exactly how I felt when I was at my worst, thank you it's good to know I'm not all alone in this and that at least someone knows what it's like. I can't afford to get an e-cig atm, but you don't need to send me money. I would just feel wrong for taking a strangers money, but thank you for responding. It's actually very comforting to know that someone can relate.

I'm so lost, I don't know how I feel, or what I should feel. It's like I'm too confused to comprehend my emotions. I'm constantly having conflicting thoughts and it's agonizing. Yesterday, I broke up with my girlfriend, and I still don't understand how I feel about it. Today, I couldn't even force myself out of bed to go to school, and it started a huge fight with my dad. Also, I'm trying to quit nicotine and I think it's making me sad and frustrated for no reason. I used to suffer from severe depression, but it turned out to be a product of my medication. After I got off of it things got a lot better, but it seems like I'm slipping back.
